headline: With Switch 2, iPhone, and laptop tricks, the Sharge Disk Pro 2 is finally a worthy EDC
summary: The Sharge Disk Pro 2 Ultra is a highly recommended portable SSD. It stands out with its additional function as a 4K HDMI dock. This device offers significant improvements over previous Sharge models.

headline: Apple’s new AirTags are back down to their best price
summary: Apple AirTags are currently available for $89, a $10 discount. This price matches the all-time low for the four-pack bundle. The deal is available at Amazon, Target, and Costco (for members).

headline: Google Earth’s AI deepfake tool only lasted one day
summary: Google Earth launched an AI tool allowing users to edit satellite images with text prompts. This feature enabled the creation of 'AI deepfakes' of real-world locations. Google quickly shut down the controversial tool after only one day.

headline: The NHTSA is investigating 1.2 million Tesla vehicles over suspension failure reports
summary: The NHTSA is investigating nearly 1.2 million Tesla vehicles. The probe focuses on complaints regarding potential suspension failures. Affected models include 2018-2020 Model 3 and 2021-2023 Model Y, citing loss of directional control.

headline: Everything Coming to Netflix in August 2026
summary: Netflix is set to release a new lineup of content in August 2026. Upcoming titles include 'Chucky,' 'Fast and Furious,' and 'The Whisper Man.' Ricky Gervais will also voice a cartoon cat in a new addition.

headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Leak on Social Media Reportedly Seen by Millions Before Sony Took It Down
summary: Spider-Man: Brand New Day has reportedly suffered a major leak on social media. A high-quality bootleg version spread rapidly across platforms like X/Twitter. Sony eventually removed the leaked content after it was viewed by millions.

headline: Everything Coming to Disney+ in August
summary: Disney+ is releasing a 'stacked lineup' of new content in August. New additions include titles from Star Wars, X-Men, Pokémon, and Disney Princesses. Surprisingly, League of Legends content is also joining the streaming service.

headline: Amazon Is Having a Lord of the Rings T-Shirt Sale This Weekend
summary: Amazon is hosting a special Lord of the Rings T-shirt sale. Fans can find discounted themed apparel this weekend. The sale offers a chance to grab merchandise from the popular franchise.

headline: Fifa scraps World Cup investment plan after outcry
summary: Fifa has cancelled its controversial plan to sell stakes in major competitions. Fifa boss Gianni Infantino stated the project 'created divisions.' The investment initiative will no longer proceed as planned.

headline: Labour's Bev Craig elected Greater Manchester mayor, succeeding Andy Burnham
summary: Labour's Bev Craig has been elected as the new Greater Manchester mayor. She will succeed the outgoing mayor, Andy Burnham. Craig secured nearly double the votes compared to her Reform UK opponent.

headline: Spain's PM blames traffickers after 60,000 migrants reach Ceuta from Morocco
summary: Spain's Prime Minister blames traffickers after 60,000 migrants arrived in Ceuta from Morocco. Most migrants reportedly returned to Morocco by Friday evening. Italy suspended its Schengen free movement agreement with Madrid in response.

headline: Police release Nancy Guthrie ransom notes in latest bid to find kidnappers
summary: Police have publicly released Nancy Guthrie's ransom notes. Investigators hope specific 'linguistic characteristics' in the notes will be recognized. This is a new effort to identify and apprehend the kidnappers.
